description: The xzibit_datasets_copy dataset is designed to manage and organize project-related data, including metadata and configuration details. It is particularly useful for data analysts, project managers, and IT professionals who need to track and manage various datasets and their attributes. The dataset includes columns that capture essential information such as project keys, dataset identifiers, and names, which help in uniquely identifying and categorizing datasets. It also includes metadata about the data source type, format, and connection parameters, which are crucial for understanding how data is stored and accessed. Additionally, the dataset provides information on the management status, feature group inclusion, and the number of metrics checks, which are important for data governance and quality assurance. The dataset also tracks modification details, including who last modified the dataset and when, providing an audit trail for data changes. This comprehensive dataset is ideal for organizations looking to streamline their data management processes, ensure data quality, and maintain a clear record of data modifications and configurations.
shortDesc: Dataset for managing project data with metadata and configurations.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each project, key for categorization.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for datasets, key for identification.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Name of the dataset, used for identification.

columns.name: exists
columns.comment: Indicates if the dataset currently exists, boolean value.

columns.name: type
columns.comment: Type of data source, e.g., PostgreSQL, Snowflake.

columns.name: formatType
columns.comment: Format of the dataset, e.g., csv, json.

columns.name: params.connection
columns.comment: Connection details for data source, e.g., snowflake.

columns.name: managed
columns.comment: Indicates if dataset is managed, boolean value.

columns.name: params.mode
columns.comment: Mode of data access, e.g., table.

columns.name: params.table
columns.comment: Table name in the database, includes project key.

columns.name: params.schema
columns.comment: Schema name in the database, e.g., demo.

columns.name: params.path

columns.name: creationTag.lastModifiedBy.login

columns.name: creationTag.lastModifiedOn

columns.name: versionTag.lastModifiedBy.login

columns.name: versionTag.lastModifiedOn

columns.name: shortDesc

columns.name: description

columns.name: params.metastoreDatabaseName
columns.comment: Name of the metastore database, text format.

columns.name: params.folderSmartId
columns.comment: Smart ID for folder, text format.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the dataset, JSON array.

columns.name: featureGroup

columns.name: num_metrics_checks
columns.comment: Number of metrics checks performed, integer value.
